title: एकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 89 · Lomasha arrives with news of Arjuna

summary.en: As Dhaumya speaks, the sage Lomasha arrives from Indra's heaven. He tells the Pandavas that Arjuna has received the Pashupata weapon from Shiva and weapons from Yama, Kubera, Varuna and Indra, and is learning music from the Gandharvas.
summary.kn: ಧೌಮ್ಯರು ಮಾತಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ಲೋಮಶ ಋಷಿ ಇಂದ್ರಲೋಕದಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಶಿವನಿಂದ ಪಾಶುಪತಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನೂ ಯಮ, ಕುಬೇರ, ವರುಣ, ಇಂದ್ರರಿಂದ ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳನ್ನೂ ಪಡೆದು ಗಂಧರ್ವರಿಂದ ಸಂಗೀತ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆಂದು ಪಾಂಡವರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: धौम्य के बोलते-बोलते ऋषि लोमश इन्द्रलोक से आते हैं। वे पाण्डवों को बताते हैं कि अर्जुन ने शिव से पाशुपत और यम, कुबेर, वरुण तथा इन्द्र से अस्त्र पाए हैं और गन्धर्वों से संगीत सीख रहे हैं।
summary.te: ధౌమ్యుడు మాట్లాడుతుండగా లోమశ మహర్షి ఇంద్రలోకం నుండి వస్తాడు. అర్జునుడు శివుని నుండి పాశుపతాస్త్రాన్ని, యముడు, కుబేరుడు, వరుణుడు, ఇంద్రుల నుండి అస్త్రాలను పొంది గంధర్వుల వద్ద సంగీతం నేర్చుకుంటున్నాడని పాండవులకు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: தௌம்யர் பேசிக்கொண்டிருக்கும்போது லோமஶ முனிவர் இந்திரலோகத்திலிருந்து வருகிறார். அர்ஜுனன் ஶிவனிடம் பாஶுபதத்தையும், யமன், குபேரன், வருணன், இந்திரனிடம் அஸ்திரங்களையும் பெற்று, கந்தர்வர்களிடம் இசை கற்கிறான் என்று பாண்டவர்களிடம் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ധൗമ്യൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്നതിനിടെ ഇന്ദ്രലോകത്തുനിന്ന് ലോമശൻ എത്തുന്നു. ശിവനിൽനിന്ന് പാശുപതാസ്ത്രവും യമൻ, കുബേരൻ, വരുണൻ, ഇന്ദ്രൻ എന്നിവരിൽനിന്ന് ആയുധങ്ങളും അർജുനൻ നേടിയെന്നും ഗന്ധർവന്മാരിൽനിന്ന് സംഗീതം പഠിക്കുകയാണെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പാണ്ഡവരോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.89; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवं संभाषमाणे तु धौम्ये कौरवनन्दन ।
लोमशः सुमहातेजा ऋषिस्तत्राजगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: While Dhaumya was speaking in this way, joy of the Kurus, the sage Lomasha of great radiance arrived there.

verses.text:
तं पाण्डवाग्रजो राजा सगणो ब्राह्मणाश्च ते ।
उदतिष्ठन्महाभागं दिवि शक्रमिवामराः ॥

meaning.en: The eldest Pandava, the king, with his company and those brahmins, rose to greet that fortunate sage, as the immortals in heaven rise for Indra.

verses.text:
तमभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
पप्रच्छागमने हेतुमटने च प्रयोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, king of dharma, honoured him properly and asked the reason for his coming and the purpose of his wandering.

verses.text:
स पृष्टः पाण्डुपुत्रेण प्रीयमाणो महामनाः ।
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा हर्षयन्निव पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Questioned by the son of Pandu, the great-minded sage, pleased, spoke in soft words that seemed to delight the Pandavas.

verses.text:
संचरन्नस्मि कौन्तेय सर्वलोकान्यदृच्छया ।
गतः शक्रस्य सदनं तत्रापश्यं सुरेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, I roam through all the worlds as I please. I went to the abode of Indra and there saw the lord of the gods.

verses.text:
तव च भ्रातरं वीरमपश्यं सव्यसाचिनम् ।
शक्रस्यार्धासनगतं तत्र मे विस्मयो महान् ।
आसीत्पुरुषशार्दूल दृष्ट्वा पार्थं तथागतम् ॥

meaning.en: There I also saw your brother, the hero Savyasachin, seated on half of Indra's throne. Tiger among men, I was greatly amazed to see Partha in such a place.

verses.text:
आह मां तत्र देवेशो गच्छ पाण्डुसुतानिति ।
सोऽहमभ्यागतः क्षिप्रं दिदृक्षुस्त्वां सहानुजम् ॥

meaning.en: The lord of the gods then told me, "Go to the sons of Pandu." So I have come swiftly, wishing to see you and your younger brothers.

verses.text:
वचनात्पुरुहूतस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
आख्यास्ये ते प्रियं तात महत्पाण्डवनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: At the word of Indra and of the great Partha, dear Pandava, I will tell you great and welcome news.

verses.text:
भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्कृष्णया चैव तच्छृणु ।
यत्त्वयोक्तो महाबाहुरस्त्रार्थं पाण्डवर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: King, listen, together with your brothers and Krishna. The mighty-armed one, whom you sent for weapons, has obtained them.

verses.text:
तदस्त्रमाप्तं पार्थेन रुद्रादप्रतिमं महत् ।
यत्तद्ब्रह्मशिरो नाम तपसा रुद्रमागतम् ॥

meaning.en: Partha has gained from Rudra that matchless, mighty weapon called Brahmashiras, which came to Rudra through austerity.

verses.text:
अमृतादुत्थितं रौद्रं तल्लब्धं सव्यसाचिना ।
तत्समन्त्रं ससंहारं सप्रायश्चित्तमङ्गलम् ॥

meaning.en: Savyasachin obtained that fearsome weapon that rose from the nectar, together with its mantra, its withdrawal and its propitiatory rites.

verses.text:
वज्रं चान्यानि चास्त्राणि दण्डादीनि युधिष्ठिर ।
यमात्कुबेराद्वरुणादिन्द्राच्च कुरुनन्दन ।
अस्त्राण्यधीतवान्पार्थो दिव्यान्यमितविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, descendant of Kuru, Partha of boundless valour has also learned the thunderbolt and other divine weapons, the staff and the rest, from Yama, Kubera, Varuna and Indra.

verses.text:
विश्वावसोश्च तनयाद्गीतं नृत्तं च साम च ।
वादित्रं च यथान्यायं प्रत्यविन्दद्यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: From the son of Vishvavasu he duly gained song, dance, chant and instrumental music according to the rules.

verses.text:
एवं कृतास्त्रः कौन्तेयो गान्धर्वं वेदमाप्तवान् ।
सुखं वसति बीभत्सुरनुजस्यानुजस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Thus, with his weapons mastered, the son of Kunti has gained the gandharvas' science, and Bibhatsu, your younger brother's younger brother, lives happily.

verses.text:
यदर्थं मां सुरश्रेष्ठ इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।
तच्च ते कथयिष्यामि युधिष्ठिर निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, listen as I tell you also why the best of the gods spoke these words to me.

verses.text:
भवान्मनुष्यलोकाय गमिष्यति न संशयः ।
ब्रूयाद्युधिष्ठिरं तत्र वचनान्मे द्विजोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: He said, "Best of brahmins, you will surely go to the world of men. Tell Yudhishthira from me:

verses.text:
आगमिष्यति ते भ्राता कृतास्त्रः क्षिप्रमर्जुनः ।
सुरकार्यं महत्कृत्वा यदाशक्यं दिवौकसैः ॥

meaning.en: "Your brother Arjuna, his weapons mastered, will soon return to you, after doing great work for the gods that the heavenly beings could not do themselves.

verses.text:
तपसा तु त्वमात्मानं भ्रातृभिः सह योजय ।
तपसो हि परं नास्ति तपसा विन्दते महत् ॥

meaning.en: "Join yourself and your brothers to austerity, for nothing is higher than austerity, and by austerity one attains greatness.

verses.text:
अहं च कर्णं जानामि यथावद्भरतर्षभ ।
न स पार्थस्य संग्रामे कलामर्हति षोडशीम् ॥

meaning.en: "And I know Karna truly, best of Bharatas. In battle he is not worth a sixteenth part of Partha.

verses.text:
यच्चापि ते भयं तस्मान्मनसिस्थमरिंदम ।
तच्चाप्यपहरिष्यामि सव्यसाचाविहागते ॥

meaning.en: "Also, the fear in your mind, tamer of foes, I will remove when Savyasachin comes here.

verses.text:
यच्च ते मानसं वीर तीर्थयात्रामिमां प्रति ।
तच्च ते लोमशः सर्वं कथयिष्यत्यसंशयम् ॥

meaning.en: "And as for your inner wish about this pilgrimage, Lomasha will tell you everything without doubt.

verses.text:
यच्च किंचित्तपोयुक्तं फलं तीर्थेषु भारत ।
महर्षिरेष यद्ब्रूयात्तच्छ्रद्धेयमनन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever fruit of austerity there is at the holy fords, Bharata, this great sage will tell you, and you should believe it without any doubt."
